target: Windows - current live client, Update 50 / Season One as of 2026-08-06

areas.name: Live Client and Account Route
areas.location_cue: The Windows login screen, megaserver selector, roster, Stories menu, and Collections menu.

items.label: Use the current Windows live client

levels.1: Confirm the server banner before creating the completion character.
levels.2: Use the production Windows client on Update 50; exclude test-server systems.
levels.3: Record megaserver, owned content, subscription state, and patch. Complete features reachable on 2026-08-06; add Update 51 only after production release.

levels.1: Check Collections and Stories before choosing a region.
levels.2: List every owned chapter, downloadable region, dungeon pack, class, and account unlock; mark subscription access separately.
levels.3: Distinguish permanent ownership from subscription rental in Stories, Collections, the account page, and store. Finish accessible gameplay; do not treat unavailable promotions or paid cosmetics as missing save progress.

levels.1: Reserve character slots for class and decision coverage.
levels.2: Keep one character per playable class and alternates for incompatible quest states.
levels.3: Create all seven classes, preserve one principal world-completion character, and use alternates for exclusive choices because an online character state cannot be locally restored.

areas.note: Snapshot: Update 50 / Season One on 2026-08-06. Test-server and future Update 51 material are excluded.

save_backup.title: Record this character state first
save_backup.why: Online choices and dated rewards cannot be restored from a local save.
save_backup.detail: Capture the journal and collection state; use another character for exclusive outcomes, and finish dated rewards before their window closes.

point_of_no_return.title: Finish both sides before confirming
point_of_no_return.why: This online character cannot reload an earlier state.
point_of_no_return.detail: Clear every available pre-commitment objective, then use another character for an incompatible result.

levels.1: Keep earning account experience after the character cap.
levels.2: Unlock every Champion star and save legal slotted configurations in all disciplines.
levels.3: Earn enough points for every passive and slottable star, test the maximum slots in each constellation, and save role builds in the Armory. The repeatable numeric ceiling is progression, not finite content.

levels.1: Train native lines before borrowing another class line.
levels.2: Unlock subclassing, collect every eligible borrowed line, and save legal configurations.
levels.3: Finish the introduction, rank every class line on its native character, test every legal replacement and morph through respecs, and save damage, healing, and tank builds. Restore native lines for Class Mastery.

levels.1: Keep a separate Armory state for transformation play.
levels.2: Acquire Werewolf and raise its refreshed skill line to maximum.
levels.3: Finish the introduction, unlock both morph paths and all passives, use Prowl, build Fury, trigger Rampage, and earn the three gameplay transformation styles. Use another character for a simultaneous alternate state.

levels.1: Preserve an alternate character or Armory plan before transforming.
levels.2: Acquire Vampirism and reach the final skill rank.
levels.3: Complete its introduction, test every stage, unlock all actives, passives, ultimate, and both morph paths, then record cured and transformed states on separate characters when content reacts differently.

areas.name: Auridon
areas.location_cue: The named settlements, roads, ruins, caves, and activity icons within Auridon.

levels.1: Follow the local diamond-marked path before leaving the region.
levels.2: In Auridon, clear every quest carrying the Zone Guide story marker.
levels.3: Open the Auridon Zone Guide and finish each displayed story segment plus any journal prerequisite. Recheck the guide after the final hand-in; use another character for an incompatible resolution.

items.label: Complete every side quest in Auridon

levels.1: Investigate black quest arrows around roads and settlements.
levels.2: Sweep every settlement, road junction, delve entrance, and discovered landmark in Auridon.
levels.3: Finish every non-repeatable side quest in Auridon, then revisit cleared hubs for follow-ups. Complete each distinct daily variant once; its unique reward catalogue is tracked by the repeatable entry.

levels.1: Explore gaps between unlocked travel points.
levels.2: Turn every unfinished Auridon icon white, including striking locales and special entrances.
levels.3: Enter each icon's discovery radius and clear any objective that keeps it black. Reopen the Zone Guide until every permanent exploration category is filled; group instances remain separate checks.

items.label: Read every lorebook assigned to Auridon

levels.1: Inspect readable objects near ruins, camps, desks, and roads.
levels.2: Use the Lore Library and Auridon map to identify every unread fixed book assigned here.
levels.3: Interact with every counted book in Auridon. If a quest interior changes, locate its replacement copy in the open world and confirm the library entry rather than retaining a physical item.

levels.1: Try every local water type with suitable bait.
levels.2: Catch every named rare fish listed for Auridon across all water types present.
levels.3: Use matching bait at each water type in Auridon; keep moving when a hole empties until every regional rare entry registers. Angler grouping and fishing passives only accelerate the process.

levels.1: Watch the skyline and interior side routes for a blue-white beam.
levels.2: Clear the local skyshard counter in the Auridon Zone Guide, including instanced shards.
levels.3: Collect all 16 shards assigned to Auridon. Use the verified landmark entries below, then the in-game clue for any unresolved shard; the set is done only when its local counter is full.

levels.1: Search the broader Auridon landscape and its marked interiors.
levels.2: The shard belongs at Vulkhel Guard in Auridon; inspect that landmark and its adjoining path.
levels.3: Travel to Vulkhel Guard, follow its accessible route to the beam, and interact until absorption completes. For a delve or public dungeon, search the interior rather than its exterior marker.

levels.3: Travel to Valano Manor, follow its accessible route to the beam, and interact until absorption completes. For a delve or public dungeon, search the interior rather than its exterior marker.

areas.name: Crafting, Research, Recipes, and Motifs
areas.location_cue: Crafting hubs, writ boards, set stations, traders, regional coffers, and knowledge menus.

levels.1: Keep every research slot running and save unknown traits.
levels.2: Research all nine traits on every craftable weapon, armor, and jewelry type.
levels.3: Consume one item for every missing trait, reduce timers with passives or scrolls, and continue until every research row shows nine. Preserve scarce Nirnhoned and jewelry examples for ready slots.

levels.1: Deconstruct unfamiliar gear and certify each discipline.
levels.2: Max Alchemy, Blacksmithing, Clothing, Enchanting, Jewelry, Provisioning, and Woodworking.
levels.3: Finish certifications; buy every material, extraction, and improvement passive; learn all reagent and rune effects; complete top-tier daily writs and one master writ for each applicable profession.

items.label: Learn every obtainable recipe and furnishing plan

levels.1: Search containers and rotate regional, event, and voucher vendors.
levels.2: Clear every obtainable food, drink, formula, blueprint, diagram, pattern, praxis, design, and sketch entry.
levels.3: Read every unlearned plan, confirm it at the correct station, buy permanent voucher plans, and farm active regional or event sources. Retired and store-only plans stay in the availability ledger.

levels.1: Investigate special workbenches in completed regions.
levels.2: Visit each permanent crafted-set site and meet its trait threshold.
levels.3: Activate every profession bench at each crafted-set location, make one valid piece per set, and verify reconstructable or attunable access where owned.

areas.name: Antiquities, Sets, Museums, Collections, and Housing
areas.location_cue: Antiquities, Set Collections, museums, Collections, Housing Editor, and furnishing vendors.

items.label: Complete every obtainable Antiquities codex entry

levels.1: Act on each lead promptly because acquired leads expire.
levels.2: Scry and excavate every current lead through all codex stages and fragment rewards.
levels.3: Max Scrying and Excavation, obtain every active lead, excavate before its thirty-day timer ends, and repeat until codices fill. Assemble every mythic, mount, pet, furnishing, style, emote, and siege fragment.

levels.1: Bind new pieces before selling or deconstructing them.
levels.2: Fill all current overland, dungeon, trial, arena, PvP, and special set pages.
levels.3: Bind or deconstruct every eligible armor, weapon, and jewelry slot; reconstruct every perfected variant; track crafted, mythic, and non-collection sets in their own interfaces.

items.label: Complete every zone museum and fragment display

levels.1: Keep unusual fragments for their matching exhibit.
levels.2: Finish every permanent museum, tapestry, relic, instrument, mural, and multi-piece region collection.
levels.3: Obtain each named fragment from its real quest, enemy, excavation, dungeon, or exploration source; place every piece, then verify the finished display and reward. Unresolved fragments receive no invented diagram.

levels.1: Inspect collection categories after every activity reward.
levels.2: Unlock every currently obtainable gameplay mount, pet, costume, personality, memento, emote, skin, marking, outfit style, dye, title, and furnishing collectible.
levels.3: Work through permanent activity sources, claim and activate each reward, and confirm its entry. Store, crate, preorder, promotion, subscription, and retired-event items remain availability records.

levels.1: Visit homes and furnishing vendors as regions open.
levels.2: Acquire every gold- or quest-obtainable home and fill every permanent housing collection.
levels.3: Purchase permanently gold-listed homes, claim quest homes, place all functional stations and collectible furnishings once, complete houseguest and music-box sets, test pathing, and save a finished primary residence.

areas.note: Acquired leads expire and carry the online-state warning.

save_backup.title: Record this character state first
save_backup.why: Online choices and dated rewards cannot be restored from a local save.
save_backup.detail: Capture the journal and collection state; use another character for exclusive outcomes, and finish dated rewards before their window closes.

areas.name: Tales of Tribute
areas.location_cue: The card-club hall, patron collection, club ranks, matchmaking, and daily boards.

levels.1: Follow the card-club invitation in its expansion hub.
levels.2: Finish tutorials; unlock the club, queues, daily boards, and starter patrons.
levels.3: Complete every club quest, reach final NPC rank, defeat all founders and master opponents, unlock competition, and claim each rank reward.

items.label: Unlock every patron and card upgrade

levels.1: Check quests, activities, fragments, and ranked rewards.
levels.2: Acquire every patron, assemble each deck, and replace each base card with its obtainable upgrade.
levels.3: Complete patron access conditions, gather every deck fragment, win required matches, earn or buy every upgrade, and verify all upgraded faces in Collections.

levels.1: Practice patron control before ranked play.
levels.2: Reach maximum club rank and complete every distinct daily and tournament objective.
levels.3: Win against every NPC difficulty, finish all daily variants, reach the top seasonal tier once while active, and claim unique cosmetics and furnishings. Leaderboard placement remains rotating.

areas.note: Ranked seasons rotate and cannot be restored locally.

save_backup.why: Online choices and dated rewards cannot be restored from a local save.
save_backup.detail: Capture the journal and collection state; use another character for exclusive outcomes, and finish dated rewards before their window closes.

areas.name: Alliance War, Imperial City, Battlegrounds, and Veterancy
areas.location_cue: Campaign selectors, alliance bases, queues, city entrances, and the Veterancy tab.

levels.1: Earn Alliance Points across all permanent PvP modes.
levels.2: Advance one character through every Alliance Rank and both Alliance War skill lines.
levels.3: Capture and defend objectives, complete missions, heal allies, and defeat opponents until final lifetime rank. Unlock every Assault and Support skill, morph, rank reward, dye, title, gear item, and furnishing.

levels.1: Travel with an alliance group and explore beyond keeps.
levels.2: Discover every delve, shard, town, cave, gate, dolmen, and landmark; complete each board category.
levels.3: Clear all PvE objectives, gather territory shards when gates permit, capture each objective type, complete every board variant, and earn Emperor once before a suitable campaign resets.

levels.1: Bank carried currency while learning district and sewer routes.
levels.2: Clear every district event, sewer encounter, shard, quest, and roaming boss family.
levels.3: Finish both group dungeons separately; clear all district and sewer quests, shards, bosses, objectives, and permanent currency rewards. Bank frequently because opposing players can take carried currency.

items.label: Complete every Battleground mode and map

levels.1: Learn objectives before chasing eliminations.
levels.2: Win every active ruleset on every live map and clear permanent progression.
levels.3: Perform every scoring action, win every map and mode, finish permanent daily variants, and collect all obtainable styles, furnishings, titles, and gear. Rotated maps stay in the availability ledger.

levels.1: Claim rewards while earning Alliance Points.
levels.2: Reach rank 100 during the active season and claim every one-time reward.
levels.3: Progress through Cyrodiil, Imperial City, and Battlegrounds; claim milestones manually; unlock Vengeance perks and season-only rewards before rollover. Repeatable rank-100 rewards are tracked separately.

levels.1: Learn its preset roles before tuning a build.
levels.2: Join the permanent campaign and unlock all Soldier, Vanguard, Battle Medic, and Scout abilities.
levels.3: Complete a campaign cycle, test all four roles and each loadout ability, apply every earned perk, capture every objective type, and claim campaign rewards. Veterancy rewards still rotate.

areas.note: PvP rankings, Emperor, map rotations, and seasonal rewards depend on server state.

levels.3: Finish its prologue if available, all main and side quests, zone-guide categories, events, dailies, collectibles, systems, and group challenges. Detailed entries elsewhere are authoritative.

items.label: Complete the Season One Tamriel Tome

levels.1: Advance daily and weekly challenges before spending points.
levels.2: Unlock every numbered and bonus page before 2026-10-21.
levels.3: Complete and reroll challenges deliberately, unlock each page, spend points on every unique eligible reward, and keep no more than the allowed rollover amount. Paid tracks are entitlements, not mandatory purchases.

levels.1: Check the Daggerfall refuge and season prompts after July 8.
levels.2: Finish the new guild and Sheogorath questlines, every Favor, and each Dynamic Encounter variant.
levels.3: Complete both questlines without exposing outcomes, unlock all heists and guild dailies, clear every Favor and Dynamic Encounter condition, and collect their gameplay rewards. Use alternates for exclusive dialogue results.

levels.1: Read its notice before spending tickets.
levels.2: During each active event, finish every unique daily and acquire all rewards offered that cycle.
levels.3: Earn tickets without exceeding the wallet cap, complete every objective variant, open boxes until current style pages and collectibles are learned, assemble fragments, and buy missing pieces before closure.

levels.1: Do not treat its old entrance as routinely permanent.
levels.2: Record Opulent Ordeal and each Night Market reward as unavailable, returned, or currently accessible.
levels.3: If no official return is active, mark its clear and rewards unavailable-now. If it returns, complete the trial and reward catalogue only within the announced window.

items.label: Audit retired and paid account items

levels.1: Keep monetized cosmetics separate from gameplay completion.
levels.2: Classify store, crate, preorder, promotion, subscription, event, and retired-service items by current availability.
levels.3: Record owned, purchasable, rotating, retired, and unobtainable items without presenting purchases as required play. Claim free offers while live; never invent recovery paths for expired promotions.

save_backup.detail: Capture the journal and collection state; use another character for exclusive outcomes, and finish dated rewards before their window closes.
